cardOverview.overviewText: An Icon card positioned as a premium lifestyle product, delivering milestone rewards, global acceptance, and lifestyle perks for affluent users.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy a B1G1 offer and a discount up to ₹200 on movie tickets twice a month at www.BookMyShow.com.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary access to fine dining privileges at premium restaurants, including a complimentary glass of premium wine or dessert.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Browse available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining discounts. Complete the payment using your RBL Icon credit card to unlock the offer.
